title: Inspect History and Line Diffs
description: Make two distinct edits, inspect the exact diff before staging, and review the project history using compact logging.
steps: In `hcc-git-practice`, open `hello.txt` and add a new line: 'Git makes collaboration simple.'
Run `git diff` in your terminal — observe lines starting with `+` (added) in green
Stage and commit: git add hello.txt && git commit -m "docs: update hello.txt with collaboration note"
Add another line to `hello.txt`: 'Learning with HCC.'
Stage the change: git add hello.txt
Run `git diff --staged` (or `--cached`) — observe the staged diff against the last commit
Commit: git commit -m "docs: add HCC community note"
Inspect history: `git log --oneline` — observe your clean list of commit hashes and messages
View the last commit in full detail: `git show HEAD`
expected_output: Terminal shows `git log --oneline` listing all 3 commits with their 7-character hashes and messages.
tips: Press `q` to exit the terminal pager if `git log` or `git diff` fills up your screen!
`git diff` shows unstaged changes; `git diff --staged` shows what is about to be committed.
